PROPERTIES.player_hint_1_en: Look at Amos: every square he could still use shares a row or column with row 4, column 1. So nobody else can stand at row 4, column 1, or Amos would have nowhere to go.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_2_en: Look at Cyril: every square he could still use shares a row or column with row 6, column 4. So nobody else can stand at row 6, column 4, or Cyril would have nowhere to go.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_3_en: Douglas's clue ("He was in the same area as someone else on a carpet.") needs the person on a carpet in Douglas's area on a square that does not share his row or column; that rules out squares for Douglas.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_4_en: The same kind of reasoning rules out a few more squares. Douglas's own clue ("He was in the same area as someone else on a carpet. He was beside a plant.") rules out more squares. Douglas is now the only person who can still go in row 3. So Douglas (D) must be at row 3, column 7. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_5_en: The murderer must be in Vince's area without sharing his row or column; that rules out squares for Vince.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_6_en: Suppose Bianca were at row 2, column 2: then nobody could stand in column 8. So Bianca can't be there.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_7_en: Look at Bianca: every square she could still use shares a row or column with row 1, column 6. So nobody else can stand at row 1, column 6, or Bianca would have nowhere to go.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_8_en: The same kind of reasoning rules out a few more squares. Bianca is now the only person who can still go in column 6. So Bianca (B) must be at row 6, column 6. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_9_en: With the rows and columns of Douglas and Bianca crossed out, only one square is left for Cyril that fits his clue ("He was sitting in a chair."). So Cyril (C) must be at row 1, column 4. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_10_en: The murderer must be in Vince's area without sharing his row or column; that rules out squares for Vince. Eleanor's own clue ("She was west of Floyd. She was in a corner of her area.") rules out more squares. So Eleanor (E) must be at row 8, column 1. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_11_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Amos that fits his clue ("He was in the Study, but not beside a shelf."). So Amos (A) must be at row 4, column 2. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_12_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Gilbert that fits his clue ("He was in the Study or the Hall."). So Gilbert (G) must be at row 7, column 3. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_13_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Floyd that fits his clue ("He was south of Douglas."). So Floyd (F) must be at row 5, column 5. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_14_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Vince. So Vince (the victim) must be at row 2, column 8. Cross out his row and column. Douglas is the only person in the Master Bedroom with Vince, so Douglas is the murderer!
